# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/habitat-sim
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-sim

## File: facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/habitat_sim/utils/namespace/hsim_physics.py

Prompts

```
['open or close an articulated object link by setting its joint position to the max or min limit', 'check whether an articulated object link is open or closed using a normalized joint position threshold', 'get the normalized joint position of an articulated object link as a value between 0 and 1', 'get all rigid and articulated objects currently instantiated in the habitat simulator scene', 'get a managed rigid or articulated object from the simulator by its object id or instance handle']
```

Usage

```
{'open_or_close_articulated_link': 'open or close an articulated object link by setting its joint position to the max or min limit', 'check_link_open_or_closed': 'check whether an articulated object link is open or closed using a normalized joint position threshold', 'get_normalized_joint_position': 'get the normalized joint position of an articulated object link as a value between 0 and 1', 'get_all_objects_in_scene': 'get all rigid and articulated objects currently instantiated in the habitat simulator scene', 'get_object_by_id_or_handle': 'get a managed rigid or articulated object from the simulator by its object id or instance handle'}
```
